title: 第24章 地窖第25章 失踪
content_zh:
楚庭城主府的白玉阶在晨光中泛着霜雪般的光泽，江雪寒广袖迎风翻卷，袖口金丝绣纹流转间，三百道碧色流光如星雨般倾泻而出。
那些流光在半空划出玄妙轨迹，每一道都精准他带来的三百名修士手中，化作一枚青玉竹签。
这三百修士被他按天干之数分成了十部，每部皆由一名玄根境修士和两名灵蜕境修士带领二十七名尘胎境弟子组成。
二十七名尘胎境弟子，在部中又按每九人一队分成三个小队，许星遥所处的便是甲部三队，他还被任命成为了小队长。
林澈、周若渊、瑶溪歌三人倒是同样被分在了戊部二队，部中的一名灵蜕境修士正是莫怀远师兄。
林澈差点捏断手里的竹签，道：“莫师兄昨晚分组的时候一定贪杯了，他明明知道我们四人相熟，为什么单单把你分出去？我去找他求情更换一下。”
“林师弟，不要鲁莽。”
周若渊制止道，“星遥和溪歌师姐都颇通治毒之法，莫师兄也许是为了能够更快推进禁煞任务，才把星遥分出去。”
“那也不能单独分星遥一个人啊，我还是去找莫师兄，把我换到星遥的小队，这样互相也有个照应啊！”
林澈依旧道。
“林师兄，我知道你是为了我好，但莫师兄这样做必定有他的道理，况且现在马上就要开始执行任务，怎好再为了这点小事去麻烦莫师兄。”
许星遥也开口道。
“可是……”
林澈还想说些什么。
“没事的，我那小队也不是没有熟人，你们还记得韩冰吗？他就跟我同队。
而且我所在的甲部，专门负责凡人逍遥散事宜，遇到隐雾宗修士的概率可比你们小得多，说不得我反而比你们安全呢。”
许星遥说道，“好了，周师兄和我被任命为各自小队的队长，时候也不早了，我们还得去召集其他队员。”
说罢，便离开了。
“韩冰怎么能跟我们相比嘛……”
许星遥离开后，林澈小声嘟囔道。

这一切都落在了莫师兄眼里。
其实昨夜分组的时候，他是把四人同样分到了自己所在的队伍。
但当他把名单交给江雪寒的时候，江雪寒却皱起了眉头。
“我知你看重许小子。”
江雪寒指了指许星遥的名字，“但你如果总把他护在自己羽翼之下，他如何成长？有些事情总该他自己面对。”
“可是，此次禁煞毕竟困难重重……”
“你还只当他是个药圃里侍弄灵草的幼童？他虽然良善，却不软弱。
平日不过因为有飞红峰的周小子在，他不用分心这些事情而已。”
江雪寒鬓角泛着霜色，“雏鹰总要离巢见见血！”
莫师兄迟疑道：“那我把他分到甲部如何？甲部负责凡人事宜，相对安全些，他曾经救治过凡人，也有经验。”
江雪寒无奈苦笑，“你啊！”
可却终究没有再说出阻止的话。
许星遥召集齐了自己的队员后，见到队伍中的韩冰冲他点头示意，许星遥也默默给了个坚定的眼神作为回应。
许星遥带着自己的队员，来到甲部集合处，对着玄根境长老报道：“甲部三队许星遥，携全体队员报到。”
那名玄根境的长老叫做李天海，见三支小队都集齐了之后，开口道：“我甲部三十人专门负责凡人逍遥散事宜，虽然可能会少些争斗，但这三十城所辖范围极广，凡人城镇也很是分散，这任务可算不得轻。
如果在执行任务过程中遇到了外宗修士，切莫鲁莽行动，安全为上。”
众人应声称是。
“依诸位之见，我们该如何察查逍遥散？”
content_en:
The white jade steps of the Chuting City Lord's Mansion glowed like frost and snow in the morning light. Jiang Xuehan's wide sleeves rolled up in the wind, and as the golden thread embroidered patterns on the cuffs flowed, three hundred streams of blue light poured out like star rain.
Those streams of light drew mysterious trajectories in the mid-air, and each one was precise. In the hands of the three hundred monks he brought, they turned into a sapphire bamboo stick.
These three hundred monks were divided into ten groups by him according to the number of Heavenly Stems. Each group was composed of one Mysterious Root Realm monk and two Spiritual Slough Realm monks leading twenty-seven Dust Fetus Realm disciples.
The twenty-seven disciples of the Mortal Realm were divided into three squads according to the team of nine people. Xu Xingyao was in the third squad of Division A, and he was also appointed as the squad leader.
Lin Che, Zhou Ruoyuan, and Yao Xige were also assigned to the second team of the Wu Division. One of the Spirit Slaughter Realm monks in the team was Senior Brother Mo Huaiyuan.
Lin Che almost broke the bamboo stick in her hand and said, "Senior Brother Mo must have been greedy when we were divided into groups last night. He clearly knew that the four of us were familiar with each other, so why did you only get separated? I'll go to him to beg for a replacement."
"Junior Brother Lin, don't be reckless."
Zhou Ruoyuan stopped him and said, "Both Xingyao and Senior Sister Xi Ge are well versed in poison treatment. Senior Brother Mo may have separated Xingyao in order to advance the task of banning evil faster."
"Then we can't leave Xingyao alone. I'd better go find Senior Brother Mo and switch me to Xingyao's team, so that we can take care of each other!"
Lin Che still said.
"Senior Brother Lin, I know you are doing it for my own good, but Senior Brother Mo must have his own reasons for doing this. Besides, the mission is about to begin, so why bother bothering Senior Brother Mo for such a trivial matter."
Xu Xingyao also spoke.
"But..."
Lin Che wanted to say something else.
"It's okay. It's not like I don't know anyone in my team. Do you remember Han Bing? He's on the same team as me.
Moreover, the Department A where I belong is responsible for the affairs of the mortals. The probability of encountering a monk from the Hidden Mist Sect is much smaller than that of you. It is impossible to say that I am safer than you. "
Xu Xingyao said, "Okay, Senior Brother Zhou and I have been appointed as captains of our respective teams. It's getting late. We still have to gather other team members."
After that, he left.
"How can Han Bing compare with us..."
After Xu Xingyao left, Lin Che muttered softly.
All this fell into the eyes of Senior Brother Mo.
In fact, when they were divided into groups last night, he assigned the four of them to his own team.
But when he handed the list to Jiang Xuehan, Jiang Xuehan frowned.
"I know you value Mr. Xu."
Jiang Xuehan pointed to Xu Xingyao's name, "But if you always protect him under your wings, how will he grow? There are some things that he should face by himself."
"However, this ban on evil spirits is very difficult after all..."
"You still just think of him as a young boy tending magic herbs in the medicine garden? Although he is kind, he is not weak.
On weekdays, he doesn't have to be distracted by these things because Zhou Xiaozi from Feihongfeng is here. "
Jiang Xuehan's temples were covered with frost, "The young eagle must leave the nest and see blood!"
Senior Brother Mo hesitated and said: "Then how about I assign him to Department A? Department A is responsible for mortal matters and is relatively safe. He has treated mortals before and has experience."
Jiang Xuehan smiled helplessly, "You!"
But after all, he didn't say anything to stop him.
After Xu Xingyao gathered all his team members, he saw Han Bing in the team nodding at him, and Xu Xingyao silently gave him a firm look in response.
Xu Xingyao brought his team members to the gathering place of Department A and reported to the elders of the Mysterious Root Realm: "Xu Xingyao, Team A, Third Team, is reporting with all the team members."
The elder of the Mysterious Root Realm was named Li Tianhai. After seeing the three teams gathered together, he said: "The thirty people in our Department A are responsible for the affairs of the mortals. Although there may be fewer fights, the area under the jurisdiction of these thirty cities is very wide, and the mortal towns are also very scattered. This task is not an easy one."If you encounter a monk from outside the sect during the execution of a mission, do not act recklessly. Safety is the top priority. "
Everyone should claim it is.
"In your opinion, how should we check Xiaoyaosan? "
